_comment: Bump ref, re-render with tools/render_docs.py --dims <checkout>, then commit. render_docs.py --check clones this ref from GitHub, so a ref without these files fails the build. docs/index.md is mapped to index.html and replaces the generated card grid; remove that entry and build_index() takes over again.
